# Archival Dispatch: 17 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Mary Sothern, Radio Pioneers Audio Files, Paul Harvey, and Bob and Ray

**Date**: 2026-08-21  
**Author**: radio index  
**Tags**: The Life of Mary Sothern, Minabelle Abbott, William Conrad, Alan Ladd, Elspeth Eric, Tom Collins, Paul Harvey, Bob and Ray, 1957 Chevrolet, Charlie Spivak, Tito Guizar, Original Filenames

---

## Batch 75 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 75 recovers and dates 17 historical broadcasts and archival audio profiles across 1930s daytime dramatic serials, oral histories of Golden Age radio giants, Paul Harvey news commentaries, mid-century commercial advertising jingles, swing transcriptions, and network radio satire: 3 episodes of ***The Life of Mary Sothern*** (Mutual, March 1937, starring Minabelle Abbott), 5 retrospective audio tributes from ***Audio Files*** (celebrating William Conrad, Alan Ladd, Elspeth Eric, Barry Thomson, and Tom Collins), 2 classic commentaries from ***Paul Harvey News and Comment*** (1980–1983), 3 regional midwestern singing commercials from ***Allied Radio Artists*** (1958), 2 Armed Forces Radio Service musical showcases from ***AFRS Collection*** (Charlie Spivak with Garry Stevens and Tito Guízar), Bob and Ray's dry satire on ***Merchandising Ice Cubes*** (CBS, 1959), and the landmark 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air introduction spot on ***The Commercial Collection***.
